what_cannot_be_shown: The ledger has no pre-request timestamp and no gate-measured interval, so the real spacing of this release cannot be proven to be >= 3.2 s or < 3.2 s after the fact.

The cause of the 0.27 s shortfall is NOT established: a log-write stall or a wall-clock adjustment is plausible, but an idle-machine measurement of append latency (max 3.6 ms) does not reproduce it. It is not claimed to be a logging error.
The source returned a normal response to all 1,876 requests (no throttling response), which is an observation, not proof of compliance.
